title: The Day the Sun Stood Still
themeTags: nothing is too hard for God
reflectionQuestion: Joshua prayed a bold prayer, and God made the sun stand still. I wonder what big thing you would like to ask the God who can do anything?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Joshua category, Joshua 10). The unforgettable VISUAL (the sun standing still) is the replay hook. WATCH-ITEM: SOFT on battle -- no fighting/gore; the enemy is 'frightened' and 'ran away'; God sends hail to drive them off (kept light, not deadly-detailed); framing is rescue of friends + God's power, NOT war. The HEART = nothing is too hard for God / bold prayer / God answers + fights for his people. Joshua marches all night to RESCUE friends in danger (heroic, protective). Soft close ('you'). VOICE_JAMES_HUSKY (ear-verified male; steady leader register).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies. Isn’t this written in the book of Jashar? The sun stayed in the middle of the sky, and didn’t hurry to go down about a whole day.
